priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, ideally when energy is low or just before using Berserk/Incarnation.
Use Berserk or Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane while Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Chomp (Ravaging Chomp) whenever the Chomp Enabler buff is active.
Use Feral Frenzy or Frantic Frenzy if you have 2 or fewer Combo Points (up to 4 during Berserk).
Cast Convoke the Spirits if Tiger's Fury is active and you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Use Ferocious Bite immediately if Apex Predator's Craving procs.
At 5 Combo Points, use Primal Wrath if the bleed on targets is missing or has less than 6.5 seconds remaining.
Spend 4 or 5 Combo Points on Ferocious Bite (or Ravage) if Primal Wrath's bleed is already well-maintained on your targets.
Maintain Rake on as many targets as possible (up to 5) if they are refreshable.
Maintain Moonfire on all targets if talented into Lunar Inspiration.
Use Swipe as your primary builder when facing 3 or more targets, or at any time during Berserk.
Use Shred as a builder only when facing exactly 2 targets if Swipe is not empowered.
Use Regrowth to spend Predatory Swiftness procs if you are talented into Bloodtalons or need the utility.
In combat, use Shadowmeld to enable a stealth-empowered Rake if available.
Always ensure you are in Cat Form before attacking.
